role: frequency-ordered word list (seed-only language: the app bundles the whole list, nothing to download)
generationVersion: gen-tatoeba-words.py v1 (HKeyboard scripts/; Batch 8 added the tamil script filter, whose vowel signs / virama / anusvara are letters of the word)
generationCommand: python gen-tatoeba-words.py --lang ta --script tamil --min-count 2 --stop "டாம்,டோம்,மேரி,மேரியுடன்,மேரியை" --out ta_words.txt tam_text.txt
transformations: gen-tatoeba-words.py: tokens of Tamil letters and their combining marks; Tatoeba placeholder names dropped (--stop); words seen fewer than 2 times dropped; ordered by count desc then first occurrence
no corpus sentence is redistributed - the file is a word list only
note: The app bundles the whole list (Tatoeba attests only 299 words at min-count 2); nothing is downloaded.
